Name: Beautiful Bachelors
Author: SeaQueen91
Description:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/headers/48375_1783349282.jpg[/img]

Beautiful Bachelors is a Portraiture mod that gives Stardew Valley’s vanilla bachelors a polished visual glow-up.

I noticed there are a lot of beautiful portrait overhauls for the women of Stardew Valley, but far fewer focused on the men. This mod was originally made for just myself, but now is available for players who also wanted the bachelors to feel more romantic, stylish, and visually appealing while still keeping their recognizable personalities and charm.

The portraits were created using access to paid AI models, then further edited and refined in Photoshop to improve consistency, expression, details, and usability in-game.

Beautiful Bachelors currently includes all starting vanilla bachelors:
Alex, Elliott, Harvey, Sam, Sebastian, and Shane.

Each has their standard portrait sheet, plus winter and beach. A few have their Joja Mart counterparts as well.
[heading]Installation Instructions[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b]. [/*]
[*]Install the [b]Portraiture[/b] mod and all of its requirements. [/*]
[*]Download and unzip [b]Beautiful Bachelors[/b]. [/*]
[*]Place the portrait folders/images into the appropriate Portraiture folder. [/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley. [/*]
[*]Use Portraiture in-game to select the Beautiful Bachelors portrait set. [/*]
[/list][heading]Main Features[/heading]
Beautiful Bachelors is a simple portrait image replacement set for Portraiture.
Features include:
[list]
[*]High-resolution bachelor portraits [/*]
[*]Glow-up style artwork for all starting vanilla bachelors [/*]
[*]Multiple expressions for each character [/*]
[*]Portraiture-compatible image files [/*]
[*]No gameplay changes [/*]
[*]No dialogue changes [/*]
[*]No character schedule changes [/*]
[*]Safe to install or uninstall whenever[/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements[/heading]
This mod requires:
[list]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b] [/*]
[*][b]Portraiture[/b] [/*]
[*]Any requirements needed by Portraiture [/*]
[/list]Beautiful Bachelors does not work as a standalone portrait replacement without Portraiture. Remember to put image portraits into your portraiture folder via Portraiture/Portraits/Beautiful Bachelors. You will likely need to hit the 'p' key when speaking with the respective bachelor to change their portrait. For additional logistics on that, see the Portraiture mod page.
